messages:
mike: Heads-up — saw a small but steady spike in partial-stream responses this morning (08:12–08:40 UTC). ~1.2% of livechat sessions returned only an initial chunk then stalled. Alert triggered SLO-p95 stream duration.

ana: Looking at LB + edge traces now. Handshake completes, we get first token frames, then no further tokens for ~4–6s before client reconnect. Second connection usually resumes fine. Feels like a keepalive / client backoff mismatch.

devon: Repro steps: run client-sdk v1.4.2 against canary runtime with 10ms packet loss emulation. I can reproduce token stop after first frame. Async decode falls back to CPU and we see a KV-cache eviction spike right before stall.

nina: Who wants mitigation? I can push a canary tweak (lower stream idle timeout, add periodic heartbeat frames) and run 24h synthetic traffic. Willing to own monitoring and rollout. :+1:

mike: Nina assigned to mitigation (48h). Devon to investigate async-decoder + kv-cache eviction root cause (ETA 5d). Ana to own post-canary verification and SLA impact report (ETA 72h).

ana: Plan for canary config (pushed to staging first):
```
stream.keepalive_interval_ms = 15000
stream.max_idle_before_backoff_ms = 30000
client.reconnect_policy = "linear:250ms,500ms,1s"
```
I'll also enable more verbose streaming traces for 72h.

devon: For root cause I'll instrument cache eviction counters and async-worker latency. If eviction correlates, plan is to adjust eviction threshold + add a soft backpressure so we don't drop kv entries mid-request.

ops-bot: Synthetic job created: `synthetic/stream-regression-check` — runs every 6h, posts summary to #eng-oncall.

nina: Canary rollout schedule: staging -> 10% prod (6h) -> 50% (12h) -> 100% if no regressions. I'll abort on >0.5% partials or error-rate delta >0.2%.

mike: Also: add a recurring postmortem check — correlate with deployments and k8s preStop hooks. Noted a pattern with pods that had short terminationGracePeriod. Owner: ana, recurring cadence: weekly for 4 weeks.

ana: I'll add the check to the incident tracker and create a short runbook snippet for oncall: quick triage steps, where to find traces, which metrics to look at.

mike: Tagged owners and ETAs in the action item list. Will follow up in 48h on mitigation status in this thread. Thanks all. :rocket:
